topic: The Magic of Pure Fourier Series: Decomposing Complexity

sections.title: The Hook: The Musical Analogy
lecture_lines: Complex periodic signals are musical chords.
Fourier series act like a mathematical prism.
Signals decompose into simple sine notes.
animations: Display the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/instrument.svg] in #FFFF00 representing a pure frequency.
Fade in a sine wave graph in #00FF00 beside the musical note icon.
Show three sine waves of different frequencies overlaying to create a complex signal, visualized through the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].

sections.title: Prerequisite: Orthogonality of Sine/Cosine
lecture_lines: Periodic functions form an orthogonal basis.
Like a grid, they measure frequency.
Sine waves define our coordinate system.
animations: Display the inner product integral symbol in #FF00FF.
Show a sine wave and a cosine wave shifting out of phase on a graph plotted over a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Animate the multiplication and integration of these two waves, showing the area result as zero.

sections.title: The Core Formula: Breaking it Down
lecture_lines: Average value is the constant term.
animations: Display the Fourier series summation formula in #FFFFFF with clear labeling.
Highlight the fundamental frequency term of the series in #00FFFF.
Animate individual harmonic terms being added one by one to a base wave.
Animate the sum as it progressively approximates a square wave function.
Label the coefficients A_n and B_n next to their respective sine and cosine terms in #FF8000.

animations: Show the definite integration operation on a signal in #FFFF00.
